code: International Code of Signals (1965 edition, in force 1969)

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="A flag, Alfa"><defs><clipPath id="c7aecca2c"><path d="M0 0H90L66 30L90 60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#c7aecca2c)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="45" height="60" fill="#ffffff"/><rect x="45" y="0" width="45" height="60" fill="#0b3d91"/></g><path d="M0 0H90L66 30L90 60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: I have a diver down; keep well clear at slow speed.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="B flag, Bravo"><defs><clipPath id="c7a2cf00a"><path d="M0 0H90L66 30L90 60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#c7a2cf00a)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="90" height="60" fill="#c8102e"/></g><path d="M0 0H90L66 30L90 60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: I am taking in, or discharging, or carrying dangerous goods.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="C flag, Charlie"><defs><clipPath id="ccc04bfe6"><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#ccc04bfe6)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="90" height="12.2" fill="#0b3d91"/><rect x="0" y="12" width="90" height="12.2" fill="#ffffff"/><rect x="0" y="24" width="90" height="12.2" fill="#c8102e"/><rect x="0" y="36" width="90" height="12.2" fill="#ffffff"/><rect x="0" y="48" width="90" height="12.2" fill="#0b3d91"/></g><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: Affirmative: “yes”, or the previous group is to be read as affirmative.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="D flag, Delta"><defs><clipPath id="c4ea3e744"><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#c4ea3e744)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="90" height="60" fill="#ffcc00"/><rect x="0" y="15" width="90" height="30" fill="#0b3d91"/></g><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: Keep clear of me; I am manoeuvring with difficulty.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="E flag, Echo"><defs><clipPath id="c6a1c2bb1"><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#c6a1c2bb1)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="90" height="30" fill="#0b3d91"/><rect x="0" y="30" width="90" height="30" fill="#c8102e"/></g><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: I am altering my course to starboard.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="F flag, Foxtrot"><defs><clipPath id="c9188e313"><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#c9188e313)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="90" height="60" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="M45 0L90 30L45 60L0 30Z" fill="#c8102e"/></g><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: I am disabled; communicate with me.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="G flag, Golf"><defs><clipPath id="c47f8430a"><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#c47f8430a)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="15.2" height="60" fill="#ffcc00"/><rect x="15" y="0" width="15.2" height="60" fill="#0b3d91"/><rect x="30" y="0" width="15.2" height="60" fill="#ffcc00"/><rect x="45" y="0" width="15.2" height="60" fill="#0b3d91"/><rect x="60" y="0" width="15.2" height="60" fill="#ffcc00"/><rect x="75" y="0" width="15.2" height="60" fill="#0b3d91"/></g><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: I require a pilot.
flags.note: Made by fishing vessels working close together on the fishing grounds: “I am hauling nets”.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="H flag, Hotel"><defs><clipPath id="c2f521abf"><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#c2f521abf)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="45" height="60" fill="#ffffff"/><rect x="45" y="0" width="45" height="60" fill="#c8102e"/></g><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: I have a pilot on board.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="I flag, India"><defs><clipPath id="c9515c075"><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#c9515c075)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="90" height="60" fill="#ffcc00"/><circle cx="45" cy="30" r="16" fill="#111111"/></g><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: I am altering my course to port.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="J flag, Juliett"><defs><clipPath id="c30de14c5"><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#c30de14c5)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="90" height="20.2" fill="#0b3d91"/><rect x="0" y="20" width="90" height="20.2" fill="#ffffff"/><rect x="0" y="40" width="90" height="20.2" fill="#0b3d91"/></g><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: I am on fire and have dangerous cargo on board: keep well clear of me, or I am leaking dangerous cargo.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="K flag, Kilo"><defs><clipPath id="cff842520"><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#cff842520)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="45" height="60" fill="#ffcc00"/><rect x="45" y="0" width="45" height="60" fill="#0b3d91"/></g><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: I wish to communicate with you.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="L flag, Lima"><defs><clipPath id="c7c0eb4a7"><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#c7c0eb4a7)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="45" height="30" fill="#ffcc00"/><rect x="45" y="0" width="45" height="30" fill="#111111"/><rect x="0" y="30" width="45" height="30" fill="#111111"/><rect x="45" y="30" width="45" height="30" fill="#ffcc00"/></g><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: You should stop your vessel instantly.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="M flag, Mike"><defs><clipPath id="c5afde1ac"><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#c5afde1ac)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="90" height="60" fill="#0b3d91"/><path d="M0 0L90 60M90 0L0 60" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="13"/></g><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: My vessel is stopped and making no way through the water.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="N flag, November"><defs><clipPath id="c537807bc"><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#c537807bc)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="22.7" height="15.2" fill="#0b3d91"/><rect x="0" y="15" width="22.7" height="15.2" fill="#ffffff"/><rect x="0" y="30" width="22.7" height="15.2" fill="#0b3d91"/><rect x="0" y="45" width="22.7" height="15.2" fill="#ffffff"/><rect x="22.5" y="0" width="22.7" height="15.2" fill="#ffffff"/><rect x="22.5" y="15" width="22.7" height="15.2" fill="#0b3d91"/><rect x="22.5" y="30" width="22.7" height="15.2" fill="#ffffff"/><rect x="22.5" y="45" width="22.7" height="15.2" fill="#0b3d91"/><rect x="45" y="0" width="22.7" height="15.2" fill="#0b3d91"/><rect x="45" y="15" width="22.7" height="15.2" fill="#ffffff"/><rect x="45" y="30" width="22.7" height="15.2" fill="#0b3d91"/><rect x="45" y="45" width="22.7" height="15.2" fill="#ffffff"/><rect x="67.5" y="0" width="22.7" height="15.2" fill="#ffffff"/><rect x="67.5" y="15" width="22.7" height="15.2" fill="#0b3d91"/><rect x="67.5" y="30" width="22.7" height="15.2" fill="#ffffff"/><rect x="67.5" y="45" width="22.7" height="15.2" fill="#0b3d91"/></g><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: Negative: “no”, or the previous group is to be read as negative.
flags.note: Visual or sound signalling only; by voice or radio the signal is “NO”.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="O flag, Oscar"><defs><clipPath id="c9cbd7a0e"><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#c9cbd7a0e)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="90" height="60" fill="#ffcc00"/><path d="M0 0H90V60Z" fill="#c8102e"/></g><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: Man overboard.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="P flag, Papa"><defs><clipPath id="c46a8091f"><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#c46a8091f)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="90" height="60" fill="#0b3d91"/><rect x="30" y="15" width="30" height="30" fill="#ffffff"/></g><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: In harbour: all persons should report on board, as the vessel is about to proceed to sea.
flags.note: At sea, made by fishing vessels: “My nets have come fast upon an obstruction”. Traditionally called the Blue Peter.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="Q flag, Quebec"><defs><clipPath id="cdfaaddea"><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#cdfaaddea)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="90" height="60" fill="#ffcc00"/></g><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: My vessel is “healthy” and I request free pratique.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="R flag, Romeo"><defs><clipPath id="c49532e1f"><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#c49532e1f)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="90" height="60" fill="#c8102e"/><rect x="0" y="23" width="90" height="14" fill="#ffcc00"/><rect x="38" y="0" width="14" height="60" fill="#ffcc00"/></g><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: No meaning as a single flag.
flags.note: Before 1969 it meant “The way is off my ship; you may feel your way past me”.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="S flag, Sierra"><defs><clipPath id="cb0215ec4"><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#cb0215ec4)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="90" height="60" fill="#ffffff"/><rect x="30" y="15" width="30" height="30" fill="#0b3d91"/></g><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: I am operating astern propulsion.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="T flag, Tango"><defs><clipPath id="c36bc4cfe"><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#c36bc4cfe)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="30.2" height="60" fill="#c8102e"/><rect x="30" y="0" width="30.2" height="60" fill="#ffffff"/><rect x="60" y="0" width="30.2" height="60" fill="#0b3d91"/></g><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: Keep clear of me; I am engaged in pair trawling.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="U flag, Uniform"><defs><clipPath id="c2c3b0c89"><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#c2c3b0c89)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="45" height="30" fill="#c8102e"/><rect x="45" y="0" width="45" height="30" fill="#ffffff"/><rect x="0" y="30" width="45" height="30" fill="#ffffff"/><rect x="45" y="30" width="45" height="30" fill="#c8102e"/></g><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: You are running into danger.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="V flag, Victor"><defs><clipPath id="c38e94976"><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#c38e94976)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="90" height="60" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="M0 0L90 60M90 0L0 60" stroke="#c8102e" stroke-width="13"/></g><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: I require assistance.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="W flag, Whiskey"><defs><clipPath id="c08312bc7"><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#c08312bc7)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="90" height="60" fill="#0b3d91"/><rect x="18" y="12" width="54" height="36" fill="#ffffff"/><rect x="30" y="21" width="30" height="18" fill="#c8102e"/></g><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: I require medical assistance.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="X flag, X-ray"><defs><clipPath id="c46281a28"><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#c46281a28)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="90" height="60" fill="#ffffff"/><rect x="0" y="23" width="90" height="14" fill="#0b3d91"/><rect x="38" y="0" width="14" height="60" fill="#0b3d91"/></g><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: Stop carrying out your intentions and watch for my signals.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="Y flag, Yankee"><defs><clipPath id="c7bd6ca93"><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#c7bd6ca93)"><rect x="0" y="0" width="90" height="60" fill="#ffcc00"/><path d="M-45 60L-30 60L30 0L15 0Z" fill="#c8102e"/><path d="M-15 60L0 60L60 0L45 0Z" fill="#c8102e"/><path d="M15 60L30 60L90 0L75 0Z" fill="#c8102e"/><path d="M45 60L60 60L120 0L105 0Z" fill="#c8102e"/><path d="M75 60L90 60L150 0L135 0Z" fill="#c8102e"/></g><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: I am dragging my anchor.

flags.svg: <svg class="flag" viewBox="-1 -1 92 62" role="img" aria-label="Z flag, Zulu"><defs><clipPath id="cfa51217c"><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#cfa51217c)"><path d="M0 0H90L45 30Z" fill="#ffcc00"/><path d="M0 0L45 30L0 60Z" fill="#111111"/><path d="M0 60L45 30L90 60Z" fill="#c8102e"/><path d="M90 0L45 30L90 60Z" fill="#0b3d91"/></g><path d="M0 0H90V60H0Z" fill="none" stroke="#14212b" stroke-opacity=".35" stroke-width="1"/></svg>
flags.meaning: I require a tug.
flags.note: Made by fishing vessels working close together on the fishing grounds: “I am shooting nets”.
